title: Speak naturally, using a few clear phrases.
intro: You do not need to memorize a dictionary. Start with the phrases below; similar wording such as “be quiet,” “main page,” or “never mind” is also understood. If more than one safe destination fits, JoIn will ask a short follow-up question.

steps.title: Choose your language
steps.text: Choose English, French, or Arabic from the interface language selector.

steps.title: Say one request
steps.text: Use a short sentence and pause when you finish.

steps.title: Listen or interrupt
steps.text: Use the visible controls whenever speech or processing is active.

groundingTitle: Questions are grounded in the current page
groundingText: JoIn can summarize and explain readable content currently rendered on the website. It does not answer general-knowledge questions or invent information that is not available on the current page.
versionText: When listening is paused, the microphone is genuinely stopped and cannot hear “resume.” Use the visible Resume button. While the system is speaking or processing, use the displayed Stop talking or Cancel button for an immediate interruption.
followupText: If JoIn asks a choice question, you can answer with the option, “the first one,” “yes,” “no,” or “never mind” in your selected language. Only the six most recent turns are held temporarily in this browser session, and the history is cleared when voice mode is turned off.
formsTitle: Form actions are drafts until you submit
formsText: JoIn reads back ordinary field values and highlights the changed control so you can check it. Passwords are never read aloud or shown in voice diagnostics. Signing in or creating an account always requires a separate confirmation.
